editorial:
Picture a retired mobster who thought he left the violent life behind, only to get ambushed and pumped full of 22 bullets by someone he once called a brother. That is the wild setup of this French crime thriller, and it pulls you in fast. You follow a tough, aging gangster who should be dead but refuses to stay down. Instead of hiding, he goes on a revenge spree that is messy, personal, and full of old grudges. The vibe is gritty and serious, with a strong focus on loyalty, betrayal, and the cost of living by the gun. The lead performance carries a lot of weight.

The action is sharp without going over the top, and the pacing keeps you moving from one confrontation to the next. The acting is solid, especially from the lead, who brings real emotion to a man pushed too far. On the downside, some side characters feel thin, and a few plot turns are easy to guess. Still, if you enjoy revenge thrillers with heart and grit, this one is worth your time. Stream it in 4K Ultra HD on Prime Video, rent it on Apple TV, or grab the 4K Blu-ray.
endingExplained: In the final act, the retired mobster tracks down his former friend and the gang that betrayed him. After a brutal showdown, he kills the man who ordered the hit, but not before learning the betrayal was tied to old debts and family secrets. Instead of walking away clean, he chooses to protect his family by faking his death and disappearing. The twist is that his survival was never about revenge alone; it was about making sure his loved ones never face the same violent world he did.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves revenge thrillers and gritty crime dramas.
